assertions.assertion: Implements IClaimsTransformation with a TransformAsync method
assertions.rationale: ApplicationRoleClaimsTransformation implements IClaimsTransformation with async Task<ClaimsPrincipal> TransformAsync.

assertions.assertion: Creates a new ClaimsIdentity and adds it to the principal via principal.AddIdentity() — does NOT mutate the existing identity in-place
assertions.rationale: Creates a new ClaimsIdentity, adds role claims to it, and calls principal.AddIdentity(identity), with an explicit warning against in-place mutation.

assertions.assertion: Loads roles from a local repository or database based on the user's subject claim
assertions.rationale: Reads JwtClaimTypes.Subject and loads roles via _roles.GetRolesForUserAsync(subjectId).

assertions.assertion: Registers the implementation with DI (e.g. AddTransient<IClaimsTransformation, ...>)
Warns against using IClaimsTransformation on the IdentityServer host for modifying token claims
assertions.rationale: Explicitly warns to use it only in the API and never on the IdentityServer host to change token content, pointing to IProfileService instead.
